text.title: Bottlenose dolphin
text.menu_sub: Swim in a pod and come up for air.
text.menu_wild: Find fish and breathe at the surface.
text.intro: Swim in the sea. Hold Down to dive, Up to come up. Breathe at the surface.
text.hungry: Look in the water for small fish.
text.no_food: No fish within reach. Swim on.
text.too_exposed: Find calm open water before resting.
text.sheltered: You can rest here in the water.
text.out_of_water: You need water. Wiggle back to the sea.
text.about_looks: A stocky grey dolphin with a white belly, a short blunt beak and a tall curved fin on its back. Adults are about 3 metres long.
text.about_food: It eats fish, squid, shrimp and eels. In this game you catch small fish.
text.about_home: It lives in the sea in groups called pods. Pods swim in warm coastal waters.
text.about_winter: It stays active all year. It does not sleep through winter and does not travel away.
text.about_young: One calf is born in the water at a time. The calf stays close to its mother and drinks her milk.
text.about_fact: Pods often have about 15 dolphins. They swim and surface together.
text.bite: A dolphin snapped at you! Swim for cover!
text.safe_tag: Tag, you got it! In Safe mode a dolphin never goes hungry.

year.shelter: It lives in the sea in groups called pods. Pods often have about 15 dolphins and swim in warm coastal waters.
